# LevelMeter

**Class:** `UltraCanvasLevelMeter` · **Group:** [Text, images and media](../Groups/Text-images-and-media.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasAudioRecorderElement.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasAudioRecorderElement.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasAudioRecorderElement.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Audio waveform, input level

## Overview

A small self-contained element that paints either a three-zone VU meter or a scrolling waveform strip inside its own (flex-provided) bounds. There is no stock widget for this, so it stays custom-drawn — but as a child element the flex layout owns its geometry, keeping it aligned with its siblings.

## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasLevelMeter(const std::string& id, float w, float h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).
